outcome: Technical success of uterine arterial embolization (UAE)
cohort: 25 patients who underwent UAE for primary postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) following cesarean section between January 2018 and December 2020 at a tertiary care center.
finding: Uterine artery embolization (UAE) is a safe and effective treatment for primary PPH following cesarean section, with a clinical success rate of 76%.
